models.period_note: no age-driven rhythm: the gait reads the walk POSITION (limbSwing, 3.0 here: cos(3 x 0.6662) = -0.416) and the walking speed, the head the look angles - every age sample is the same pose; the amplitude matrix carries the legs
models.visual_note: the Beaver's visual samples for a rig whose hook reads limbSwingAmount (g1, the Ant precedent): the bind and the full-amplitude fractions; the amplitude matrix is the setupAnim leg's
models.hook_note: the third Tier-2 slice (2026-09-13, owner's third set item 8 under Amendment 2): a HOOK rig - the shipped pose is the classic setupAnim verbatim in the descriptor's applyCustomAnimations(processor, PoseInputs); no keyframe layer, no transcription, no clip manifest (the self-gate stays closed until an artist delivers idle and walk); channels [] because tools/layer_definition_to_geo.py refuses channels on a code_driven / entity_state entry without a keyframe_reference_leg - the reference-clip sampler's span comes from its RULES row for this id (ReferenceClipSampler.RULES, the source lines cited); the animation leg proves the hook at 0 rad against the classic model at the same inputs on every sample

models.unrolled_note: the port's CaterKillerModel unrolls the 1.7.10 pose-and-draw loops into seg1_0..2 and seg2_0..5 copies (the standing reference row's declaration, tools/reference_model_proofs.json reference_caterkiller: motion_read reviewed 2026-09-02, ENT-S-091); the reference leg folds the copies back onto their source parts
models.rig_note: the classic model reads getAttacking() (the jaws, the head bob and the first segments' legs; orig ModelCaterKiller.java:248, 251, 289), so it poses through CaterKillerModel.poseFrom(CaterKillerPose, ...) from a declared state on both sides (the Slice 4b form); the head bob and the segments' z are position writes (moveTo), the rear segments' z scaled by limbSwingAmount (the amplitude matrix); the port's unrolled seg1_i / seg2_i parts are the reference row's reviewed re-expression of the 1.7.10 pose-and-draw loops (tools/reference_model_proofs.json motion_read)
